newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Discovery rejects latest Premier bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Discovery rejects latest Premier bid.

text.p: Discovery Petroleum NL said shareholders should not accept the 80 cent per share takeover bid by U.K.-based Premier Oil Plc and should wait to see if Oil Search Ltd decides to launch a rival bid.

"The board advises shareholders not to accept this revised offer but to wait for further news about what Discovery's new major shareholder, Oil Search Ltd, intends to do," Discovery chairman Peter Jones said. "Shareholders should also be aware that Discovery's major shareholder, Oil Search, has recently completed a review of Discovery's Part B Statement to help it decide whether to bid for Discovery," Jones said.
Premier last week increased its bid from 70 cents per share, but has been consistently overbid by share market speculators.

Oil Search, which is based in Papua New Guinea, recently acquired a 10.1 percent stake in Discovery for 75 cents per share. Market sources told Reuters on Thursday that Oil Search would make an announcement next Monday or Tuesday about whether or not to make a bid.
Discovery's major assets are a share in Indonesia's Kakap gas field and acreage off the Western Australian coast.
Discovery shares ended one cent higher at 81 cents.
